create_robotics_client_cloud: create a genai_robotics Client using the CLOUD connection type with an API key for robotics inference
create_robotics_client_local: create a genai_robotics Client using the LOCAL connection type with a custom gRPC URL for local inference
create_robotics_client_cloud_genai: create a genai_robotics Client using the CLOUD_GENAI connection type with an API key and project ID
generate_robotics_content: generate robotic action predictions by calling client.models.generate_content with image observations and joint positions
convert_robotics_content_to_genai_format: convert robotics observation contents including numpy arrays and tensors into the GenAI API format with JPEG compression
